name: Board Meeting
description: Formal board meeting notes covering agenda items, governance decisions, financial updates, and follow-ups.

sections.title: Meeting Metadata
sections.instruction: Date, time, location or modality, chair, secretary, and quorum status

sections.title: Attendees & Apologies
sections.instruction: List board members, guests, observers, and apologies or absences

sections.title: Agenda Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the main agenda items and the sequence in which they were discussed

sections.title: Reports Presented
sections.instruction: Capture reports presented, presenter names, key findings, and links or references if mentioned

sections.title: Resolutions & Decisions
sections.instruction: List formal resolutions, decisions, approvals, votes, abstentions, and rationale

sections.title: Risks & Governance Issues
sections.instruction: Summarize risks, compliance issues, governance concerns, and mitigations discussed

sections.title: Action Register
sections.instruction: List action items with accountable owners, deadlines, and reporting expectations
